reason: Every commercial green chutney I've ever tried tastes heavily of synthetic vinegar and citric acid rather than fresh herbs. I won't gamble ₹179 ordering online when it likely tastes like sour chemicals.
objection: Packaged hari chutney always has a pungent artificial preservative aftertaste that completely ruins samosas.
would_change_my_mind: Trial sachets on Blinkit or verified reviews proving it has that fresh, punchy dhaniya-mirchi taste without vinegar.
